title: Biology FA3 v31 dingo fence
prompt: Create a new narrow upright biology scene plate y11-dingo-fence-v1, portrait approximately1000x1500. A tall wire-netting DINGO FENCE about1.8metres high, made of fine rectangular-mesh netting supported by alternating weathered timber and plain steel posts, seen close beside it, running dead straight away from viewer toward one distant vanishing point at the horizon. Nearest whole post at bottom left/centre; fence narrows rapidly toward horizon near upper right/centre. Show the FULL nearest post from top to ground, no cropped wire or posts. Landscape on BOTH sides is the SAME flat red-earth semi-arid ground with a few low grey-green saltbushes; do not imply one side is greener or more barren. The asset is a NARROW UPRIGHT vignette that can stand between two landscape cards. Only a narrow natural wedge of ground under the fence, no vast solid rectangular background or painted sky; true transparent exterior and transparent through visible gaps above the horizon. Fine dark-ink outline makes pale wire legible on cream paper. Generous at least8percent empty margin around whole vignette. No animals, dingoes, kangaroos, people, hands, faces, signs, vehicles, gate, text, numbers, labels, barbed-wire closeup, diagram arrows, glow, halo or white border. Gentle upper-left daylight. True transparent PNG. Never stretch.
